continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 1's cliffhanger. Gerald has turned away from Juliana at the altar, leaving her devastated before the entire aristocratic congregation.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Off-screen) (Sharp, Piercing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: ...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Steely, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Powerful, Unyielding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Decisive, Scathing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: You have shown them exactly what your word is worth.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Proud)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I may leave this chapel without a husband...

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Triumphant in Spirit)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: ...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed.
